title: Tool spans start new traces when tools run in parallel
scenario: After the change assistant started calling tools in parallel, Transaction Search shows tool and tool-server spans as orphan traces and the per-conversation latency panel is wrong. Single-tool turns are fine. On-call blames propagators and sampling. Find the real break in the exported spans and the agent code.
task: Compare exported spans of parallel and single-tool turns
Find where the OTEL context is lost
Fix it while keeping tool calls parallel
Rule out the propagator and sampling theories
acceptance: One trace per turn with correct parents at both hops
ANSWER.md names the lost context with span evidence
